Maria Chen: Quick follow-up from today's security segment — dropping the live Qs here so we can assign owners and timelines.
Sanjay Patel: First: BYOK/Private KMS — can Private VPC customers bring keys and when is that realistic?
Alex Rivera: Audit logs question: default retention, enterprise options, and export SLAs? Need numbers for sales one-pager.
Jess Liu: ISO readiness — will we pursue ISO in parallel with SOC2 or reuse artifacts?
Sanjay Patel: Short plan: Private/VPC BYOK targeted in Q3 (customer KMS integration). Hosted BYOK needs HSM and policy gating, aiming Q4 and tied to SOC2 re-eval. I'll publish the gating checklist.
Tyler Nguyen: Proposed retention tiers: default 90d; enterprise adjustable up to 7y. Export hooks to S3/GCS with standard export SLA 24h, expedited 4h for pre-approved audits.
Cory Brooks: Legal flag — EU PII exports need a privacy review before promising timelines. Loop in @legal and @privacy.
Alex Rivera: Draft audit export example (JSONL single line example): {"ts":"2026-03-23T16:22:10Z","req_id":"req_abc123","actor":"svc:acme","route":"/v1/generate","model":"redwood/gpt-13b","tokens_in":42,"tokens_out":210,"outcome":"success","ip":"10.2.3.4","kms_key":"projects/foo/locations/global/keyRings/r1/cryptoKeys/k1"}
Jess Liu: ISO scope will largely map to SOC2 controls but adds supplier assessments and supply-chain risk. I'll draft a gap matrix by Friday.
Sanjay Patel: Rotation plan: KMS rotates keys; runtime will support rewrap at lease boundaries so caches can refresh without downtime. Integration tests required.
engops-bot: CI: private-kms-integration merged to staging at 2365004390 — smoke tests passing ✅
Maria Chen: Action items: 1) @Sanjay publish BYOK timeline + gating checklist (EOD next Tue). 2) @Alex draft audit-export schema + retention/pricing notes. 3) @Jess own ISO readiness/gap matrix (by Fri). 4) @Tyler produce SLA/KPI copy for external site.
Alex Rivera: I'll push schema draft to docs repo and tag security + privacy.
Tyler Nguyen: Suggested SLA numbers: p99 <= 350ms for small hosted models; monthly error budget 0.1%; audit-export SLA standard 24h, enterprise expedited 4h.
Cory Brooks: Add cost estimate for long-retention storage and egress to pricing notes.
Maria Chen: Good call on legal — @legal-bot please note we'll request review after drafts. No customer-facing promises until legal signs off.
Sanjay Patel: I'll schedule an ops sync for BYOK gating items and include runtime test owners.
Jess Liu: Will collate vendor assessments and share the ISO gap matrix.
Maria Chen: Thanks — please keep updates in this thread. If anyone hits blockers, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
